facts.form: separate chemically defined organic compound, assumed not mixed or formulated

gri_path: GRI 1: chapter 29 note 1(a) covers separate chemically defined organic compounds; heading 2905 covers acyclic alcohols

rejected_alternatives.reason: applies only to mixtures or preparations, not the pure compound
covers ether-alcohols such as dipropylene or polyethylene glycols, not propane-1,2-diol
polypropylene glycol (a polyether) is a different product

classification.rationale: Propylene glycol is a separate chemically defined acyclic diol, which chapter 29 note 1 places in chapter 29. Subheading 2905.32 names it expressly (propane-1,2-diol), and the only statistical line is 2905.32.00.00. No precedent ruling on the pure compound was found in the search, but the eo nomine subheading settles the classification.
